text: In mature knowledge domains using citation weighted reputation, foundational contributors will accumulate ten to one hundred times more reputation than equivalent quality incremental contributors, and citation graphs will exhibit power law degree distributions.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998
